articles.title: Hyundai tests AI agent commerce on JPMorgan’s Kinexys blockchain
articles.snippet: The exploration of AI agents with JPMorgan builds on Hyundai’s recent stablecoin-based cross-border remittance pilot.

articles.title: Google finds self-running AI hacking tool with Russian comments in its files
articles.snippet: Google spots an AI that can find and exploit software flaws on its own, no human needed.

articles.title: World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
articles.snippet: The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.

articles.title: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko
articles.snippet: Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, its product chief said, as the crypto data platform explores trading features.

articles.title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
articles.snippet: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue, as Project Genie adds longer sessions and new community creation and sharing tools.
